posts.text:

in 2026, i run the same kind of test on my own products with synthetic users

fathom calls → LLMs personas → browserbase → 30 simulated days https://t.co/Ra38ehy1kO

2026 年，我用合成用户在自己的产品上做同类测试

posts.author: egeberkina
posts.text:
3D modeling just got ridiculously easy

"Create a game character for me, under 10K triangles."

That's all it takes to get started!

With Hermes Agent + @MeshyAI, you can simply describe your idea in everyday language and let the agent handle the 3D generation process.

Getting started is easier than you think. Follow the setup guide here: https://t.co/PqJHMo1QFO

You can even rotate and inspect your model directly inside the chat window, then send another message whenever you want to make changes.

3D character creation, just like having a conversation!
#Hermes #MeshyAI #AI3D
posts.text_zh:
3D 建模变得简单到离谱

"帮我做一个游戏角色，三角面少于 1 万。"

只需要这一句就能开始！

用 Hermes Agent + @MeshyAI，你只要用日常语言描述想法，agent 就会处理整个 3D 生成流程。

你甚至可以直接在聊天窗口里旋转、查看模型，想改的时候再发一条消息就行。

3D 角色创作，就像聊天一样！
